examples.text: Мы не успеем, полиция уже едет!
examples.trans: We will not make it in time, the police are already coming!

examples.text: Я не успел позвонить.
examples.trans: I didn't manage to call.

examples.text: Успеем! Президент долго выступает.
examples.trans: We'll make it! The president always talks for a long time.

meanings.en: to go, to drive, to ride
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'is going (by vehicle)', paired with 'поехать'.

examples.text: Скорая помощь уже сюда приехала.
examples.trans: The ambulance has already arrived here.

examples.text: Неужели наш гость наконец съехал?
examples.trans: Could it be that our guest finally moved out?

examples.text: Поехали лучше сейчас новый телевизор купим.
examples.trans: Let us go buy a new television right now instead.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'their', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Я вообще ничего сейчас не понимаю.
examples.trans: I do not understand anything at all right now.

examples.text: Я слышал, они так часто делают.
examples.trans: I heard they often do it that way.

examples.text: Простите, я вас совсем не понимаю.
examples.trans: Excuse me, I do not understand you at all.

meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'треча'). Common feminine noun meaning 'appointment' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Я сам их встречу, бегом наверх!
examples.trans: I will meet them myself, run upstairs!

examples.text: До встречи!
examples.trans: See you!

examples.text: У меня встреча.
examples.trans: I have a meeting.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'at a run / quickly', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Я сам их встречу, бегом наверх!
examples.trans: I will meet them myself, run upstairs!

examples.text: Некогда объяснять, бегите быстрее!
examples.trans: No time to explain, run faster!

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'верх').

examples.text: Я сам их встречу, бегом наверх!
examples.trans: I will meet them myself, run upstairs!

examples.text: Да, дежурный повёл их прямо наверх.
examples.trans: Yes, the receptionist led them straight upstairs.

examples.text: Он там наверху с другими девушками гуляет!
examples.trans: He is fooling around upstairs with other girls!

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'когда').

examples.text: Некогда объяснять, бегите быстрее!
examples.trans: No time to explain, run faster!

examples.text: Лёва, давай быстрее, мне некогда!
examples.trans: Lyova, hurry up, I have no time!

examples.text: Мне некогда.
examples.trans: I have no time.

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ъяснять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to explain'.

examples.text: Некогда объяснять, бегите быстрее!
examples.trans: No time to explain, run faster!

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и объяснять вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and to explain on time.

meanings.en: to run (in one direction), to flee, to escape
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to run, to flee', paired with 'побежать'.

examples.text: Надо срочно бежать к Элеоноре!
examples.trans: I must urgently run to Eleonora!

examples.text: Беги, Марина, пока не поздно!
examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!

examples.text: Куда ты так быстро бежишь?
examples.trans: Where are you running so fast?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'faster', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Пойдём быстрее на свежий воздух.
examples.trans: Let us go quickly to the fresh air.

examples.text: Быстро в номер и всё оттуда убрали!
examples.trans: Quickly to the room and clear everything out of there!

examples.text: Некогда объяснять, бегите быстрее!
examples.trans: No time to explain, run faster!
